decision_rule: Generated plates describe a mechanism but never supply the authoritative claim. Specific agreement and listed-market figures live in source-bound local evidence surfaces.

candidates.purpose: Show commitments reserving some future factory capacity, in contrast to a separate pile of uncommitted interest.
qa: reserved and open capacity are distinct
commitment is not portrayed as total capacity
no corporate claim, text, or number is embedded

candidates.purpose: Show capital routes converging on physically distinct strategic technology bottlenecks: chips, memory, packaging, power, robotics, and defense communications.
qa: no country ranking or market valuation is embedded
capital follows capability is framed as a visual metaphor
